proof_body:
by
  intro n hn
  refine ⟨fun P h1 h2 => Polynomial.Chebyshev.leadingCoeff_le_of_forall_abs_le_one h1 h2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [Polynomial.Chebyshev.degree_T]
  · intro x hx
    exact Polynomial.Chebyshev.abs_eval_T_real_le_one (n : ℤ) (abs_le.mpr ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩)
  · simpa using Polynomial.Chebyshev.leadingCoeff_T ℝ (n : ℤ)
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → (∀ P : Polynomial ℝ, P.degree ≤ n → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |P.eval x| ≤ 1) → P.leadingCoeff ≤ 2 ^ (n - 1)) ∧ (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ n).degree ≤ n ∧ (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ n).eval x| ≤ 1) ∧ (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ n).leadingCoeff = 2 ^ (n - 1)
